payload.title: [HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-004] Surface copyable correlation hints from execution metadata
payload.body:
## Summary

When an execution row’s **`metadata`** JSON contains agreed correlation keys (e.g. request id, worker tick id), show them in the **Enqueue diagnostics** area as **copyable** text so operators can grep centralized logs.

## Scope

- In scope: Read-only display + copy UX for keys defined in implementation (document the key names in code comments or dev-docs); all three execution detail sources if `metadata` exists on each model.
- Out of scope: Ingesting new ids from external systems if not already persisted.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Engineering documents the **`metadata` key(s)** surfaced (e.g. `correlationId`, `workerTickId`) in the PR description or a short dev-docs note (PRD REQ-005 §10 gap).
- [ ] When `metadata` includes those keys and diagnostics are visible (`failed` / `partial`), each value appears with a **copy-to-clipboard** control (or native selection-friendly monospace block).
- [ ] Keys that are absent do not render empty rows.
- [ ] Unit or component tests cover: metadata present → fields shown; metadata absent → no correlation block.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-002`
- Blocks: none

## Notes

- If `metadata` is null for all sources today, this ticket may be **small**: add persistence in `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-001` for one correlation id first, then surface it here—or split a sub-task.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/hermes-enqueue-failure-diagnostics.prd.md
